sections.text:
[Effects]
Increases physical and magic Ability Power by 7XL.
Target: yourself. Recovers 20 Cost.
Target: yourself. Fills Unison gauge by 5.
Increases physical and magic attack Ability success value by L.
Ability Power scales with the number of Wind elemental Weapons equipped up to a max of 7XL+ (Gear pieces needed for maximum effect: 3).

[Activation]
When a physical or magic attack Ability is used.

[Activation Rate]
M+
Activation rate scales with the number of Wind elemental Weapons equipped up to a max of XL (Gear pieces needed for maximum effect: 3).
